transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm just having some trouble with my work. I'm a teacher, and... well, I'll sit down with a stack of essays or a curriculum document, fully intending to get through it. But... maybe ten minutes later, I'll realize I've just been staring at the exact same page. 

I just end up thinking about three other things and... barely taking in what's right in front of me. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
How long have you been experiencing these difficulties with your focus?

Um... I suppose it's been noticeably worse for... maybe 11 months or so. Give or take. The school, uh... they changed the curriculum calendar around then. And they added these after-school planning meetings. So... yeah. About that long.
Growing up as a child or teenager, did you ever struggle with your focus or attention like this?

Yeah... I suppose so. Um... even back in primary school, I guess. My report cards usually said things like I was bright but careless, or... that I wouldn't finish my work unless someone was watching me closely. And... my parents were always finding old worksheets just crumpled up at the bottom of my backpack. Stuff I just forgot to turn in. So... yeah. I guess it's always been a bit of an issue.
Do you often feel physically restless, fidgety, or like you have trouble sitting still?

No, not really. I mean... I can sit through a class or a meeting fine. I don't feel like I need to be moving around or anything. Just... my mind wanders, I guess. But physically, no. I'm usually pretty still.
Aside from the difficulties with your work, how has your overall mood been lately?
Um... fine, I suppose. I haven't really noticed anything different with it. It's just... normal. The main issue is really just the work stuff.
Do you find yourself acting on impulse, such as interrupting others or blurting things out before thinking?
No... not really. I don't think I do that. I mostly just... keep to myself.
